limitations: Inventory covers all 66 current sitemap pages; externally hosted interactive schedules, personal accounts and third-party document links are preserved as links and not mirrored.

Raw text includes all embedded popups, shared navigation and footer text. primaryText/cleanText removes shared Tilda content and forms. 47 deduplicated popup articles are stored in shared-articles.json.
Photo identification is based on dimensions and filename exclusions; some banners, awards and card graphics are included in the photo candidates.
Content and assets from dynamically loaded feed APIs are not included unless present in page HTML.
Source site contains some contradictory contact and opening-hour values; use verified contacts section and original links for current operational information.
